================================================================================
2. DXC still synthesizes the value itself, unconditionally, with the FIXME
   from PR #5142 still standing
================================================================================
File:   lib/HLSL/DxilContainerReflection.cpp
Command: git show HEAD:lib/HLSL/DxilContainerReflection.cpp

52: // Remove this workaround once newer version of d3dcommon.h can be compiled
53: // against
54: #define ADD_16_64_BIT_TYPES
55: #define ADD_SVC_BIT_FIELD
   ...
114: #ifdef ADD_SVC_BIT_FIELD
115: // Disable warning about value not being valid in enum
116: #pragma warning(disable : 4063)
117: // FIXME: remove the define once D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD added into
118: // D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_CLASS.
119: #define D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD                                                      \
120:   ((D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_CLASS)(D3D_SVC_INTERFACE_POINTER + 1))
121: #endif

File:   lib/DxilContainer/D3DReflectionStrings.cpp

   ...
345: #ifdef ADD_SVC_BIT_FIELD

347: #pragma warning(disable : 4063)
348: // FIXME: remove the define once D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD added into
349: // D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_CLASS.
350: #define D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD                                                      \
351:   ((D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_CLASS)(D3D_SVC_INTERFACE_POINTER + 1))
352: #endif
353:
354: LPCSTR ToString(D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_CLASS Class) {
355:   switch (Class) {
   ...
372:   case D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD:
373:     return "D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD";

-> `ADD_SVC_BIT_FIELD` is `#define`d unconditionally at the top of both files
   (not gated on any detected header version), so the local synthetic value
   `((D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_CLASS)(D3D_SVC_INTERFACE_POINTER + 1))` == 9 is what
   every build of DXC uses, matching the issue's own description: "DXC is
   essentially casting an integer value to D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_CLASS because
   the D3D headers haven't been updated with the new value."

3. History: introduced by the PR the issue follows up on; never touched since
================================================================================
Command: git log --all --oneline -S"D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD" -- \
           lib/HLSL/DxilContainerReflection.cpp \
           lib/DxilContainer/D3DReflectionStrings.cpp

8a8b29f96 [spirv] AMD work graphs extension (#7353)      2025-06-03
daf138616 [dxa] Add option to dump reflection (#5232)     2023-05-24
5cadb2589 Fix reflection on bitfield. (#5142)              2023-05-05

Three commits match the pickaxe search, but only one of them writes new
FIXME/workaround text; the other two are path history, not edits:

- `5cadb2589` (#5142) is where the FIXME first appears, in
  `lib/HLSL/DxilContainerReflection.cpp` and in what was then
  `tools/clang/unittests/HLSLTestLib/D3DReflectionStrings.cpp` (confirmed via
  `git show --stat 5cadb2589`, and via `git show 5cadb2589:lib/HLSL/
  DxilContainerReflection.cpp | Select-String -Pattern "FIXME: remove the
  define" -Context 0,3`, which prints the identical FIXME text).
- `daf138616` (#5232) is a pure rename of
  `tools/clang/unittests/HLSLTestLib/D3DReflectionStrings.cpp` to
  `lib/DxilContainer/D3DReflectionStrings.cpp` (`git show --stat daf138616
  --find-renames` reports "0" insertions/deletions for that path, i.e. a
  100%-similarity rename); it appears in the path-restricted pickaxe search
  above only because restricting `git show` to specific new/old paths
  suppresses rename detection and prints the moved content as a fresh "+"
  addition. No wording changed.
- `8a8b29f96` (#7353) is a single-parent, non-merge commit whose diff against
  its immediate parent (`ae3e317fff...`) shows both
  `lib/DxilContainer/D3DReflectionStrings.cpp` (693 lines) and
  `lib/HLSL/DxilContainerReflection.cpp` (3093 lines) added in full — an
  artifact of that parent commit predating these files on whatever branch
  history #7353 was integrated from, not a rewrite of their contents.

Byte-comparison of the FIXME block across these three commits and current
HEAD (`git show <rev>:lib/DxilContainer/D3DReflectionStrings.cpp |
Select-String -Pattern "FIXME: remove the define" -Context 0,3` for
`daf138616`, `8a8b29f96`, `HEAD`) shows the same comment and the same
`(D3D_SVC_INTERFACE_POINTER + 1)` cast throughout; only whitespace formatting
of the `#define` line changed (a single-line form at `daf138616`, the current
backslash-continued form from `8a8b29f96` onward), consistent with a
clang-format pass rather than a content edit. The wording and semantics have
not changed since #5142 (2023-05-05, thirteen days before this issue was
filed on 2023-04-21 -- note the issue predates #5142's merge date recorded
here; see caveat below).

CAVEAT: this issue (#5169) was filed 2023-04-21, but PR #5142's merge commit
`5cadb2589` is dated 2023-05-05 -- after the issue was filed. Per
`gh api repos/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/pulls/5142`, PR #5142 was
opened 2023-04-12T02:33:19Z and merged 2023-05-06T00:56:33Z, so the issue was
filed nine days into that PR's review, referencing its (not yet merged)
changes -- matching the issue body's own wording, "D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD is added
as macro define in ...#5142" (present tense, about an open PR).

================================================================================
Why there is no dxc invocation/probe here
================================================================================
The existing test tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheck/d3dreflect/bitfield-enum.hlsl
already exercises DXC's bitfield reflection end-to-end and expects
`Class: D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD` in the D3DReflect dump -- but running it would only
re-confirm that DXC's *behavior* (assigning the workaround value to bitfield
members) is unchanged, which is not in dispute and is not what #5169 asks to
change. It would also require building the `dxa`/D3DReflect test harness,
which is not part of the registered `main-debug` (`dxc`-only) ground-truth
build and would be a rebuild of shared build state outside this issue's
directory -- out of scope for this session. The header excerpts above answer
the only question #5169 poses (has D3D_SVC_BIT_FIELD been declared in
D3D_SHADER_VARIABLE_CLASS) directly and conclusively.
